name: 卷胡巨獭
evolution: 小鼠獭 → 燕尾獭 Lv.30 → 卷胡巨獭 Lv.48
description: 对外表有很高的追求，除了磨牙的习惯之外，体内分泌的油脂会被用来保养胡须。蓬松的胡须和锋利的牙齿代表其在族群中的地位，部分獭会去寻找枯草装作假胡子戴着。普遍不喜欢和洛克亲近。
descriptionEn: It holds itself to a very high standard of appearance; besides its habit of grinding its teeth, the oil secreted inside its body is used to care for its whiskers. Fluffy whiskers and sharp teeth represent its status within the group, and some of them seek out dead grass to wear as fake whiskers. They generally do not like getting close to Roco.
